title: A Borel L¹ density g on M with θ⟨ξ, G♭∧ω⟩ = |G|·g and g = θ⟨ξ⌞(G/|G|), ω⟩ where G ≠ 0 (parent Step 3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U (m+1) M θ ξ. Let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Borel and ω ∈ D^m(U) (a smooth m-form with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U). For w ∈ ℝ^P and an m-covector α put w♭∧α := alternatizeUncurryFin((innerSL ℝ w).smulRight α). Put ν(x) := |G(x)|⁻¹G(x), so ν(x) = 0 when G(x) = 0, and ξ_t(x) := ξ(x)⌞ν(x), i.e. ξ_t(x)(α) = ξ(x)(ν(x)♭∧α); in Lean, ξ_t(x) = (ξ x).comp ((alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖G x‖⁻¹ • G x)))). Then there is a Borel function g : ℝ^P → ℝ with the following properties: g is H^{m+1}⌞M-integrable; g(x) = 0 whenever G(x) = 0; and for H^{m+1}⌞M-a.e. x, (a) if G(x) ≠ 0 then g(x) = θ(x)·ξ_t(x)(ω(x)), and (b) θ(x)·ξ(x)(G(x)♭∧ω(x)) = |G(x)|·g(x). Here H^{m+1} = μHE[m+1].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P) (ω : TestFormOn U m), IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → Measurable G → ∃ g : Eucl P → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ Integrable g ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ (∀ x, G x = 0 → g x = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), (G x ≠ 0 → g x = θ x * (ξ x).comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖G x‖⁻¹ • G x)))) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x)) ∧ θ x * ξ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (G x)).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))) = ‖G x‖ * g x
